_comment: Complex Nutrition digestion rules (v0.2.2), used while tracking runs. Fullness: the stomach holds fullnessMax (vanilla satiety's maximum while tracking runs; vanilla's own is vanillaFullnessMax). Each food fills fullnessPerGram per gram of its weight; meals, pies and anything whose code contains one of cookedWords fill cookedFullness times that; liquids fill liquidFullness times that; grain in a porridge also counts porridgeWater times its weight in cooking water. Fullness drains fullnessDrainPerHour per in-game hour. Satiety from other mods' code for food without data fills unknownFullnessPerSatiety per point. Gut pools: eating adds grams of net carbohydrate (carbohydrate minus fibre), protein and fats; each bite is absorbed evenly over absorbHours, a pool holds at most maxGrams and the rest passes through unused. Absorbed grams give kcalPerGram calories; above diminishingAboveGrams absorbed within windowHours, an extra x grams count as diminishingScaleGrams * ln(1 + x / diminishingScaleGrams). With a fibre reserve at fiberBonusFullAt % of a day's need or more, a pool digests fiberSpeedBonus faster (less in step with a lower reserve). An empty calorie tank deals starvationDamage every starvationSeconds. After death the tank holds at least reviveCalories (% of a day). The HUD calorie bar flashes below flashBelow of a full tank.
